classification.difficultyReason: Identify repeated elements and explain why each element should be listed only once in a set.

content.prompt:
Geri asks 10 students in her class to name their favourite colour. Geri writes the results as set $A$.

$A=\{\text{green},\text{purple},\text{pink},\text{red},\text{blue},\text{red},\text{red},\text{green},\text{orange},\text{red}\}$.

Explain the mistake that Geri has made.

answer.short: Geri has repeated elements: red appears four times and green appears twice. Each colour should be listed only once.
answer.worked:
Sets have no repeated elements. Red appears four times and green appears twice, so each repeated colour should be written only once:

$A=\{\text{green},\text{purple},\text{pink},\text{red},\text{blue},\text{orange}\}$.
